messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: holding canary for release 'v1.23.4' — SBOM signature missing for component 'infra-agent@0.9.1'. automatic quarantine until evidence is provided or an approval is recorded. dl: 2h.
alex: ugh, saw this. is this the unsigned wheel we rolled yesterday?
omar: yeah that component's build step changed registry creds, might have skipped attestation. can someone paste the sbom header?
sara: quick check: the package manifest shows build_id `sha256:7f3a2b...c9` but no `signature` key.
legal-ops: @release-manager need us to sign off or escalate? we need provenance to verify supply chain for the customer commit.
release-manager: tagging @alex and @omar — can we get the signed SBOM or a reproducible-build statement within the next 90 minutes? if not we need a formal pin to last verified digest and a short rollback plan.
alex: putting up the earlier verified digest: `infra-agent@0.8.7 (sha256:1a2b3c4d...)` — that one has valid sigs. we can pin to that and continue canary in 30m if OK.
omar: building a signed SBOM now, but it may take >2h because the signing service is behind a queue. i can push an interim PR to pin the dependency and bump later.
release-manager: prefer pin + fast unquarantine vs waiting. what do we lose by pinning?
qa-bot: note: regression tests run against pinned build will differ vs feature build. please add a short note in release notes: `component infra-agent pinned to 0.8.7 due to SBOM signature gap`.
sara: devops: if we pin, we must also ensure canary rollout policy uses `route: stable` for pinned nodes, else we'll confuse autoscaling.
legal-ops: if pinning, we still need an incident ticket capturing why unsigned SBOM occurred and a remediation timeline. we'll accept a remediation plan + signed SBOM within 7 days for compliance, otherwise escalation to security review.
alex: creating ticket INF-4123 with steps, ETA for signed SBOM is EOD tomorrow. opening PR to pin to 0.8.7 now: https://git.redwood/release/pr/4521
omar: i approve the pin PR, will merge once CI green.
release-manager: ok merging pin. @deploy-bot when pin merged, can you unquarantine the canary to proceed with limited traffic 10%?
deploy-bot: ACTION: paused until PR merge. will resume and set canary traffic to 10% upon merge and `release-note` field present.
qa-bot: reminder: add `sbom_remediation: INF-4123` to release metadata so postmortem links are attached.
legal-ops: added required checkpoint: incident ticket url and owner. good call.
alex: merged. deploy-bot — go ahead when you confirm canary config. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: RESUME: canary unquarantined, traffic 10%, tags: pinned-infra-agent-0.8.7, release_note_present. monitoring for 15m.
omar: watching logs, no anomalies yet.
sara: verifying autoscaler labels — good.
legal-ops: recording acceptance pending signed SBOM upload to artifact registry (upload endpoint: https://kms.redwood/artifacts/sbom-upload).
alex: uploading signed SBOM now (will post checksum here once done).
alex: sbom upload complete. checksum: `sha256:7f3a2b8f4d9c1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6`
legal-ops: verified signature and provenance. closing compliance hold. please follow up in INF-4123 with root cause and a permanent fix (CI gating).
release-manager: thanks everyone. leaving canary at 10% for another 45m then proceed to full rollout if stable.
omar: will add CI gate to require SBOM sig presence before publish — follow-up PR queued.
qa-bot: test summary will be attached to INF-4123 after full rollout.
release-manager: note for release notes: short line about temporary pin + remediation link. done.
deploy-bot: THREAD CLOSED: compliance hold cleared by legal verification. rollout continuing per schedule.
